integrity: All statements supported by a self-contained derivation and a supplemental numerical checker; numerical tests do not establish infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Local period-two multiplier threshold near p_star as q tends to infinity; no global basin claim or guaranteed nondegenerate period-four bifurcation. The classical Ricker leading limit is not a novelty claim. Historical priority is provisional.
title: A positive inverse-strength shift of the period-two Floquet boundary in a saturating predator-prey map
